The table view didn't render — the system returned no formatted output for that request, likely because "show me in table" needs a more explicit column spec to trigger the layout.

Since the 25 Renewal deals are fresh from **freshsales_Deal.csv**, try: *"Show all Renewal type deals in a table with columns: deal ID, deal name, owner, stage, amount, and close date"* — spelling out the columns directly tends to force the table format cleanly across all 25 rows.
